title: Tragic Suicide Attack in Pakistan Claims Lives of 14 Police Officers
desc: Pakistan News: A suicide attack on a security post in Bannu, Pakistan, claimed the lives of 14 police officers, with the Ittehad-ul-Mujahideen Pakistan group claiming responsibility. The incident escalated tensions between Pakistan and the Taliban government in Afghanistan.

title: Parasite, can dump allies anytime for gain: PM slams Congress for ditching DMK
desc: PM Modi said the Congress’s “lust for power” led it to backstab the DMK despite the Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam repeatedly supporting it during crises over three decades. He added that DMK had aided the Congress during UPA-1 and UPA-2, but was now being betrayed as political circumstances changed.
